an7.47:1.1: Tena kho pana samayena Uggatasarīrassa brāhmaṇassa mahāyañño upakkhaṭo hoti:
an7.47:1.2: pañca usabhasatāni thūṇūpanītāni honti yaññatthāya, pañca vacchatarasatāni thūṇūpanītāni honti yaññatthāya, pañca vacchatarisatāni thūṇūpanītāni honti yaññatthāya, pañca ajasatāni thūṇūpanītāni honti yaññatthāya, pañca urabbhasatāni thūṇūpanītāni honti yaññatthāya.
an7.47:1.3: Atha kho Uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi;
an7.47:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.47:2.1: ‘sutaṃ me taṃ bho Gotama: aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsan' ti.
an7.47:2.2: ‘Mayā pi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa sutaṃ: aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsan' ti.
an7.47:2.4: tatiyam pi kho Uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.47:2.5: ‘sutaṃ me taṃ bho Gotama: aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsan' ti.
an7.47:2.6: ‘Mayā pi kho etaṃ brāhmaṇa sutaṃ: aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsan' ti.
an7.47:2.7: ‘Tayidaṃ bho Gotama sameti bhoto c' eva Gotamassa amhākañ ca, yad idaṃ sabbena sabban' ti. 2.
an7.47:3.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Uggatasarīraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca
an7.47:3.3: sutaṃ me taṃ bho Gotama "aggissa ādhānaṃ yūpassa ussāpanaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsan" ti. Evañ
an7.47:3.5: ahañ hi bhante aggiṃ ādhātukāmo yūpaṃ ussāpetukāmo;
an7.47:3.7: anusāsatu maṃ bhante Bhagavā, yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā' ti. 3.
an7.47:4.1: Atha kho Uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.47:4.2: ‘ahañ hi bho Gotama aggiṃ ādhātukāmo yūpaṃ ussāpetukāmo;
an7.47:4.4: anusāsatu maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo, yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā' ti.
an7.47:5.1: Aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubb' eva yaññā tīṇi satthāni ussāpeti akusalāni dukkhudrayāni dukkhavipākāni.
an7.47:5.4: Aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubb' eva yaññā evaṃ cittaṃ uppādeti
an7.47:5.5: ‘ettakā usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā vacchatariyo haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā ajā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāyā' ti.
an7.47:5.6: So ‘puññaṃ karomī' ti apuññaṃ karoti, ‘kusalaṃ karomī' ti akusalaṃ karoti, ‘sugatiyā maggaṃ pariyesāmī' ti duggatiyā maggaṃ pariyesati.
an7.47:5.7: Aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubb' eva yaññā idaṃ paṭhamaṃ manosatthaṃ ussāpeti akusalaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ. 5.
an7.47:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa aggiṃ ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubb' eva yaññā evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati
an7.47:6.2: ‘ettakā usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā vacchatariyo haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā ajā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāyā' ti.
an7.47:6.3: So ‘puññaṃ karomī' ti apuññaṃ karoti, ‘kusalaṃ karomī' ti akusalaṃ karoti, ‘sugatiyā maggaṃ pariyesāmī' ti duggatiyā maggaṃ pariyesati.
an7.47:6.4: Aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubb' eva yaññā idaṃ dutiyaṃ vacīsatthaṃ ussāpeti akusalaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ. 6.
an7.47:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa aggiṃ ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubb' eva yaññā sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabbhati ‘usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya', sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabbhati ‘vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya', sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabbhati ‘vacchatariyo haññantu yaññatthāya', sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samārabbhati ‘ajā haññantu yaññatthāya', sayaṃ paṭhamaṃ samābbharati ‘urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāyā' ti.
an7.47:7.2: So ‘puññaṃ karomī' ti apuññaṃ karoti, ‘kusalaṃ karomī' ti akusalaṃ karoti, ‘sugatiyā maggaṃ pariyesāmī' ti duggatiyā maggaṃ pariyesati.
an7.47:7.3: Aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubb' eva yaññā idaṃ tatiyaṃ kāyasatthaṃ ussāpeti akusalaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ.
an7.47:7.4: Aggiṃ brāhmaṇa ādhento yūpaṃ ussāpento pubb' eva yaññā imāni tīṇi satthāni ussāpeti akusalāni dukkhudrayāni dukkhavipākāni. 7.
an7.47:8.1: Tayo' me brāhmaṇa aggī pahātabbā parivajjetabbā, na sevitabbā.
an7.47:9.1: Kasmā cāyaṃ brāhmaṇa rāgaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo, na sevitabbo? 9.
an7.47:9.2: Ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an7.47:9.3: So kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an7.47:9.4: Tasmāyaṃ rāgaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo, na sevitabbo.
an7.47:10.1: Kasmā cāyaṃ brāhmaṇa dosaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo, na sevitabbo? 10.
an7.47:10.2: Duṭṭho kho brāhmaṇa dosena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an7.47:10.3: So kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an7.47:10.4: Tasmāyaṃ dosaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo, na sevitabbo.
an7.47:11.1: Kasmā cāyaṃ brāhmaṇa mohaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo, na sevitabbo? 11.
an7.47:11.2: Mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an7.47:11.3: So kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an7.47:11.4: Tasmāyaṃ mohaggi pahātabbo parivajjetabbo, na sevitabbo.
an7.47:11.5: Ime kho brāhmaṇa tayo aggī pahātabbā parivajjetabbā, na sevitabbā. 12.
an7.47:12.1: Tayo kho 'me brāhmaṇa aggī sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbā.
an7.47:13.2: Idha brāhmaṇa yassa te honti ‘mātā' ti vā ‘pitā' ti vā: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa āhuneyyaggi.
an7.47:13.4: Ato 'yaṃ brāhmaṇa āhuto sambhūto. Tasmāyaṃ āhuneyyaggi sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbo.
an7.47:14.2: Idha brāhmaṇa yassa te honti ‘puttā' ti vā ‘dārā' ti vā ‘dāsā' ti vā ‘pessā' ti vā ‘kammakarā' ti vā: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa gahapataggi.
an7.47:14.3: Tasmāyaṃ gahapataggi sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbo.
an7.47:15.2: Idha brāhmaṇa ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā madappamādā paṭiviratā khantisoracce niviṭṭhā ekam attānaṃ damenti ekam attānaṃ samenti ekam attānaṃ parinibbāpenti: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa dakkhiṇeyyaggi.
an7.47:15.3: Tasmāyaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaggi sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbo.
an7.47:15.4: Ime kho brāhmaṇa tayo aggī sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā sammā sukhaṃ parihātabbā.
an7.47:16.1: Ayaṃ kho pana brāhmaṇa kaṭṭhaggi kālena kālaṃ ujjaletabbo, kālena kālaṃ ajjhupekkhitabbo, kālena kālaṃ nibbāpetabbo, kālena kālaṃ nikkhipitabbo ti. 17.
an7.47:17.1: Evaṃ vutte Uggatasarīro brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.47:17.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
an7.47:17.4: Esāhaṃ bho Gotama pañca usabhasatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi, pañca vacchatarasatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi, pañca vacchatarisatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi, pañca ajasatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi, pañca urabbhasatāni muñcāmi jīvitaṃ demi;
an7.47:17.5: haritāni c' eva tiṇāni khādantu sītāni ca pāniyāni pivantu, sīto ca nesaṃ vāto upavāyatū' ti. 1.
